title: Assembly Metadata Pipeline
description: Nextflow pipeline to fetch and register assembly metadata into the Ensembl metadata database.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

output_dir.description: Path to the output directory where results will be saved.

assembly_options.title: Assembly options
assembly_options.description: Options controlling which assemblies are fetched.

taxon.description: NCBI taxon ID used to filter assemblies. Default is 2759 (Eukaryota).

date.description: Custom date to retrieve assemblies released after this date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

full_screen.description: When true, retrieves all assemblies since 2019 regardless of date.

add_gca.description: When true, uses a user-provided GCA list as input instead of fetching from NCBI.

gca_list.description: Path to a file containing a list of GCA accessions to process. Requires --add_gca.

ncbi_options.title: NCBI options
ncbi_options.description: Options for the NCBI Datasets API.

ncbi_url.description: Base URL for the NCBI Datasets API.

ncbi_params.description: Path to the JSON file containing NCBI API query parameters.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Options for the metadata database connection.

metadata_params.description: Path to the JSON file containing metadata database connection parameters (host, user, password, port, database).

db_table_conf.description: Path to the JSON file containing database table configuration.

registry_params.description: Path to the JSON file containing Ensembl registry connection parameters.
